thesis: AI coding assistant pilots stall around day 90 because organisations measure seat activation instead of changed work, leaving no evidence at the renewal decision.

claims.statement: 61% of 1,240 developers in the Northfield Developer Survey 2026 said their company's assistant pilot had no agreed success measure at launch.
In the Northfield Developer Survey 2026, weekly active use fell from 78% in month one to 41% by month three in pilots with no success measure, and from 80% to 66% in pilots that had one.
Halvorsen Research's 2026 platform team report, based on interviews at 32 companies, found the median pilot ran 94 days before a renewal decision.
In Halvorsen Research's 2026 study of 32 companies, all 9 that tracked a change in cycle time or review load renewed, against 11 of the 23 that tracked only seat activation.
A 2025 Ostrava University study of 400 pull requests found no measurable change in review time with assistant use.

gaps: The brief says its organisations, sources and figures are invented examples. Every entry needs confirming against real research before use.
